## What's new

- **New look** on all pages: black, blue and orange, with clearer buttons, knobs and faders.
- **New MIXER page**, laid out like DJ apps for phones and tablets: touch turntables with the cover art (drag the record to scratch, the outer ring to nudge), hot cue, loop, FX, key and sample pages for each deck, scrolling waveforms, VU meters and a loop of adjustable size. Tap a knob twice to reset it.
- **Four decks** on PLAY, BROWSE and MIXER: **SETTINGS → GENERAL → DECKS → 4 DECKS**.
- **Recording:** the **REC** button on every page records the mix as MP3, WAV or FLAC. On Android the recordings show up in other music apps.
- **Controllers:** Shift + browse knob zooms the waveforms on many controllers. The browse knob and the back button now work in the whole library, not only inside a playlist.
- **Windows:** MSI installer instead of a ZIP. It is not signed: if SmartScreen blocks it, choose **More info → Run anyway**. Pinch zoom with touch screens.
- **Android:** the APK is 57 MB instead of 249 MB.
- **iPhone and iPad** (new, experimental): an unsigned IPA to install with your own Apple ID, e.g. with Sideloadly. See [Installation](https://github.com/thanhtonvk/Vynix-DJ#installation).

## Fixed

- Less lag when selecting tracks, most noticeable on slow computers.
- Crashes with unreadable or damaged files on Rekordbox USB drives, e.g. when macOS denies access to the drive.
- Waveforms jumping to the start of the track with a high audio latency, and misdrawn parts on high DPI screens.

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Android 9+ (arm64) | `VynixDJ-1.1.0-android-arm64.apk` |
| iOS / iPadOS 16+ | `VynixDJ-1.1.0-ios-unsigned.ipa` |
| Windows 10+ (x64) | `VynixDJ-1.1.0-windows-x64.msi` |
| Linux x64 / ARM64 | `VynixDJ-1.1.0-linux-x64.deb` / `VynixDJ-1.1.0-linux-arm64.deb` |
| macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon) | `VynixDJ-1.1.0-macos-arm64.dmg` |
